sources: MDC GIS Area_Feature_Layers/FeatureServer/27 'Camping Sites' and /26 'Parking Lots' (https://gisblue.mdc.mo.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Discover_Nature/Area_Feature_Layers/FeatureServer), queried 2026-11-09
Esri World Imagery (summer) 800 m frame around 40.3155,-95.6255, viewed 2026-11-09
note: Corps-owned Missouri River mitigation land managed by MDC, three tracts of fields, grassland and bottomland woods (the west tract is reachable only by boat). The one primitive camping spot is a small gravel lot at the corner of C Avenue and Cable Avenue on the north side of the levee. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: one MDC primitive camping spot (map + GIS) at a small gravel lot, free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. Pin is on it. Not waterfront confirmed: the Missouri River is ~400 m south past the levee and fields.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Designated Camping Sites'; the area map (6/25/2020) puts its only 'Primitive Camping' symbol at the parking lot where C Avenue meets Cable Avenue, and MDC GIS has one 'Primitive Camping Area' point there (40.31662,-95.62614, the stored pin; lot 40.31673,-95.62612, Surface 'Gravel', Allows_Trailers 'No'). Imagery shows a small gravel pull-in (~20 x 25 m) at that gravel-road corner - drive-in for a 23-ft rig, no ford.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront): confirmed. The camp lot is north of the Missouri River levee; the river is ~400 m south across the levee, fields and a wooded strip. No pond or wetland at the lot.
Pin is the MDC camping point - fine.
Neighbouring Hoot Owl Bend Access (13836, ~740 m east) has its own MDC camping points; it is a separate MDC area with its own entry - no overlap.
Note rewritten: generic MDC text and directions dropped.

fees.source: https://mdc.mo.gov/discover-nature/activities/camping ('All camping on conservation areas is free'); the area page (https://mdc.mo.gov/discover-nature/places/aspinwall-bend) lists no fee, read 2026-11-09

hookups.source: https://mdc.mo.gov/discover-nature/activities/camping ('no RV hookups are provided at any department area'), read 2026-11-09

booking.source: https://mdc.mo.gov/discover-nature/places/aspinwall-bend (area regulations 3CSR 10-11 140: 'camping is limited to a period of 14 consecutive days in any 30-day period'; no reservation for individual camping) + https://mdc.mo.gov/discover-nature/activities/camping ('most camping is first come, first served'), read 2026-11-09
